entries.title: The race hour's weather on the 3D track: sun, cloud and rain in the light, a wet track's sheen, the trees in the wind, and the wind's marker in the world

values.label: the arrow (default): a small ink arrow printed on the paper beside the model, pointing the way the air moved, longer in a stronger wind, with the speed printed under it on a wide screen
the windsock: a striped sock on a pole by the start/finish line, standing out downwind (level by about 17 mph) and fluttering
off: no weather on the models or stills (the model as it was)

entries.look: Tracks → Mid-Ohio, 2026 · Race 1 (mainly clear, warm sun) against 2026 · Race 2 (moderate rain: greyer light, a wet sheen on the track, rain falling); Road America 2024 (17 mph, gusts 35: zoom into the woods to watch them sway); Laguna Seca 2025 · Race 1 (overcast); Streets of Detroit 2024 (drizzle). Turn the model: the arrow and the sheen belong to the world. Press 'Replay this race': the replay's track has the same weather. The years row's stills each carry their own race's weather.
